title: False start
why: Set off after sunset, couldn't see a thing, retreated to the car — Simpsons and an ice cream for dinner.

title: Knocking on the forest floor
why: Trail suspended on tree roots over hollows — 'like walking on top of an empty casket'.

title: The involuntary nap
why: Stopped for lunch at noon, discovered he was knackered, slept 90 minutes on a rock instead.

title: If you think you got bugged...
why: Thousands of bugs; caught two at once with his tongue.

title: The hidden third sign
why: Half an hour lost in long grass because two blue markers pointed at each other.

title: No way to light the stove
why: Camp set up, swim done — then the realisation: nothing to light the fire with, 6 days to go.

title: Navigation: cairns on rock
why: Blue markers on trees; over bare rock they switch to man-made rock piles — good to know in advance.

title: Saved by the waterfall trio
why: A passing mid-50s trio hands over a box of 40 waterproof matches. 'Now I can start eating like a pig.'

title: Falcon duet
why: Startled a falcon that flew across the path, perched, and screech-whistled until another replied.

title: The secret lake
why: A perfect un-campsite: soft ground by clear water, a swim, deer wandering out.

title: 'Oh wow. Moose.'
why: Voice note interrupted mid-sentence by a moose (or 'a big old deer') across the lake. 'Come on in, friend.'

title: Drinking-tube disaster
why: The clean-water pipe swings from the tree straight into... evidence of the previous camper.

title: Toilet-roll googly eyes
why: Both toilet rolls missing their cardboard — sacrificed to make googly eyes.

title: How bookings actually work
why: You book the whole campsite, not a pitch — different from the West Coast Trail.

title: The Blair Witch campsite
why: Three hikers coming the other way: 'we call this one the Blair Witch campsite. It's haunted.'

title: Skip the sunscreen
why: Biggest packing miss: a full bottle of sunscreen, useless under continuous tree cover.

title: Mosque-itos
why: A theory about why mosquitoes are called that, based on their call to prayer.

title: Way further than intended
why: Meant to have a rest day; instead pushed past H33/34/35 to a portage tip on Boundary Lake.

title: Inside the eye of a wasp
why: Evening birdcall over the lake, then stargazing through the flyless tent mesh.

title: Loon, fire, flying branch
why: VIDEO: gnarly fire going, a loon calling, and a firewood branch that nearly takes an ear off.

title: Survivor 101
why: VIDEO: lighting the fire — 'that goes to silverbush, it really does light up'.

title: Meteor shower
why: Fire going, chunky wood, and a meteor shower on a properly clear night.

title: Brother ant
why: An ant rips a feeding mosquito out of his arm. 'Nature's gnarly, man.'

title: Silver Peak: stash the bag
why: Leave the big pack at the junction, carry water and lunch in coat pockets.

title: Up Silver Peak, weightless
why: 90 minutes up and down with no bag — 'it felt really easy'.

title: Silver Lake: last water
why: Fill to the max (4 L) at Silver Lake — long dry stretch after.

title: Sign-colour confusion
why: Campsite exits: orange/yellow in, blue out — with three kinds of blue pointer at junctions.

title: Tent overboard
why: The tent rolls out of the bag, down a cliff towards the water — caught by one ledge.

title: Heaven Lake
why: Alone at Heaven Lake — 'I hope I'm not expected to give my soul to the god of the mountains.'

title: Shooting stars at 3am
why: Woke at 3, watched shooting stars, went back to sleep.

title: Snakessss
why: Two snakes, one right at his feet — 'some kind of python, but I'm not sure if they're here'.

title: Black bear rules
why: Definitely bears about, but black bears aren't a threat unless provoked or between mum and cub.

title: Good water
why: A dip at Clearwater Lake and a live taste test: 'Yep, that's good water.'

title: The Crack, demystified
why: Everyone's scared of The Crack; the crack itself 'was nothing — a gap you walk over'. The climb up is the work.

title: The salamander researcher
why: A chance meeting with a researcher counting blackback vs whiteback salamanders near the trailhead.

title: Prunk on, prunkers
why: Finish-line endorphins and a celebratory leap into the lake.

title: Pace reality-check
why: 'About 20k a day with mountains... it was already too fast really.' Budget 7–9 days to enjoy it.
